subject: Compliance add-ons: EU residency + HSM pricing options and credit model
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta@cardioai.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cardioai.io>, Oleg Novikov <oleg@cardioai.io>
Date: 2027-04-20 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify compliance add-on pricing (EU residency, HSM, audit logs)

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. The budget committee asked for a clean line-item breakdown of the "compliance add-ons" so we can map to our procurement codes. Specifically we need:

- EU data residency: price delta vs hosted (per-region surcharge or flat fee?) and whether it includes cross-region failover.
- KMS vs HSM: the economics we saw in the deck are a little fuzzy — do you price HSM as a seat (monthly) or as a usage uplift?
- Audit logs: retention tiers (30/90/365 days) and incremental cost per GB-month.
- Any one-time implementation or SOW fees (e.g., key-integration, SOC artefacts).

Also — we are exploring a blended purchasing approach: reserved capacity for inference + add-ons carved as either recurring or amortized over the term. If you can show a couple packaging options (seat amortized, per-call uplift, and a blended credit model) with example P&L numbers for a 12-month commitment, that would help.

Can you send a short note and attach the SOW + a small spreadsheet? We need this to circulate internally by EOD Friday.

Best,
Marta
Head of Procurement, CardioAI

---
Attachment: none (initial request)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@cardioai.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@cardioai.io>
Date: 2027-04-20 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify compliance add-on pricing (EU residency, HSM, audit logs)

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the list. I've attached two concise artifacts: an updated SOW (CardioAI_SOW_v2.pdf) and a small spreadsheet that maps retention tiers to per-GB pricing (AuditLog_Retention_Tiers.xlsx). Key highlights below — I'll keep numbers illustrative and we can plug your expected volume into the sheet.

1) EU residency
- Option A (Regional routing): +12% on hosted token price for EU-region residency with automated failover to EU hardware. No additional one-time fee.
- Option B (Dedicated EU pool): Monthly reserved capacity add-on (example: $12k/month for 4x A10G equivalent) — preferred when sustained throughput required.

2) KMS vs HSM
- KMS integrations: no seat fee, per-request KMS API calls billed at pass-through cost + 2% management fee.
- HSM (FKMS-backed @ customer keys): modeled as a hybrid — we offer two choices: a) HSM seat (flat monthly fee covering dedicated HSM slots + maintenance) or b) HSM on-demand where HSM operations are billed per-transaction at higher unit cost.
- Example economics (from the sheet): HSM seat amortized over 12 months equals roughly $X per 10k calls; on-demand is ~2.8x per-call.

3) Audit logs
- Tiers: 30d (base, included), 90d (+$0.01/GB-month), 365d (+$0.03/GB-month).
- Optional: compressed archival option for 2+ years at $0.007/GB-month.

4) One-time fees
- Key integration + validation SOW: typical $15k one-time (includes KMS onboarding and SOC evidence handover).
- If you require custom retention auditors (custom exports or encryption proofs), add’l SOW applies.

Packaging suggestions (spreadsheet has worked examples):
- Minimal: Hosted + 30d logs (no extra SOW)
- Compliance bundle: Regional routing + HSM on-demand + 365d logs + 1x SOW fee (example proration shown)
- Enterprise: Dedicated EU pool + HSM seats (amortized) + extended archival + premium support (SLA uplift)

Next steps: I can build two priced options tuned to your expected monthly token volume and a blended credit path if you commit to 12 months. Would you prefer a fully itemized quote or bundle pricing with a single monthly line item?

Attaching the SOW + pricing spreadsheet now.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0102

---
Attachments: CardioAI_SOW_v2.pdf, AuditLog_Retention_Tiers.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CardioAI — pricing levers for compliance add-ons (internal)

Irene/Logan — quick internal note to support negotiable levers.

- Discounting: for deals with Dedicated/reserved capacity we can offer an add-on discount up to 10% on recurring compliance charges (HSM seats, residency surcharges, log retention uplift).
- Credits: in lieu of deeper % discounts we can provide one-time implementation credits to offset the SOW (example: $30k credit amortized across first invoice).
- Bundling: prioritize HSM seat amortization + 365d log as a single "Compliance Bundle" SKU to simplify procurement.

Constraints: central finance prefers not to discount per-call line items >12% since that undermines list pricing for self-serve customers.

If CardioAI asks for a 12%+ discount we should push back and convert part of the ask into a one-time credit or additional trial credits for audit retention.

Ben
VP, Revenue Operations

---
Internal only (do not forward)

From: Marta Lopez <marta@cardioai.io>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@cardioai.io>, Oleg Novikov <oleg@cardioai.io>
Date: 2027-04-22 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Clarify compliance add-on pricing (EU residency, HSM, audit logs)

Irene — thanks for the quick turnaround and attachments. We ran the sample volumes through the spreadsheet; two follow-ups from procurement: 

1) CardioAI has a firm preference for an amortized HSM seat (predictable monthly line) rather than volatile per-call pricing. Can you provide a priced example for 3 HSM seats amortized over 12 months?

2) Our finance team is pushing for a deeper commercial concession on the compliance add-ons. They indicated they can sign a 12-month reserved capacity commitment for the inference pool if the blended concession on compliance add-ons is >= 12% (or equivalent in credits).

Given your note about limits, we'd prefer a blend: discount + implementation credit. To move quickly, can you share an initial commercial proposal we can circulate? If we can get to a blended 12% the committee will greenlight today.

--
Marta
Head of Procurement, CardioAI

Attachment: internal procurement note.pdf (referenced internally)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-04-23 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify compliance add-on pricing (EU residency, HSM, audit logs)

Marta —

Appreciate the clarity. We've modeled three firm options and one recommended path. High level: we can reach an approximate blended concession of 11-12% using a mix of modest recurring discount + a one-time implementation credit. Legal/Finance will need to approve the final numbers but this is finance-approved as a pathway.

Summary (examples baked into attached SOW):
A) Conservative (no change to list pricing) —
- HSM: 3 seats @ $9,500/seat/month (amortized)
- Residency: Regional routing +12% uplift
- Audit logs: 365d @ $0.03/GB-month
- One-time SOW: $15k (no credit)

B) Blended concession (recommended) —
- Recurring discount: 8% off recurring compliance line items (applies to HSM seats + residency uplift + retention uplift)
- One-time credit: $45,000 applied against first two invoices (covers part of SOW and integration work)
- Resulting blended concession (discount + credit amortized over 12 months) ≈ 11.2%

C) Aggressive (conditional) —
- Recurring discount: 10%
- One-time credit: $30,000
- Requires legal approval and an explicit 12-month reserved capacity commitment signed by end of week

Recommended next steps:
1) If CardioAI confirms preference for Option B, we'll issue an updated SOW (attached) and a redline-friendly commercial attachment.
2) I will request Legal/Finance to clear Option C if you need to hit a strict 12% threshold; it may take 48 hours.
3) DocuSign link and HubSpot deal update ready once you confirm option.

I attached an updated SOW and the priced examples against the volumes you shared. If you're happy, let's set a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize which option to put to your execs.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0102
